summary: Targeted retest of the HIGH-priority Retake regression from iteration_4 on Verdaleaf's live camera. Injected a canvas.captureStream(30) fake MediaStream via add_init_script (each getUserMedia call returns a NEW animated stream, so a solid-black frame check is meaningful). Ran two full shutter->Retake cycles, then flip, then flip+shutter+Retake, then close-cleanup and Use-photo-cleanup. All assertions pass: after Retake the <video> has srcObject non-null with a 'live' track, is not paused, videoWidth=640, is not marked 'invisible', and the sampled pixels are non-black (real frames painted). A second shutter after Retake produced a fresh camera-shot-preview with no 'Camera is still warming up' toast. MediaStream cleanup still works — tracks read 'ended' after both camera-close-btn and camera-use-btn. Use-photo still sets data-testid=upload-preview. No /api/detect call was triggered (per instruction).
critical_code_review_comments: CameraCapture.jsx fix looks correct:

Cleanup is now via useEffect(() => () => stop(), [stop]) — works, but stop is only recreated on component identity (useCallback with no deps), so the returned function captures the same stop closure. Fine in practice.
Verified across two Retake cycles + a flip + a flip+shutter+Retake sequence — repeatable, no black frame, no warming-up toast.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The Retake regression from iteration_4 is fixed. The pattern is: add_init_script installs a fake navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia that returns a fresh canvas.captureStream(30) each call (animate the canvas so nonBlackFrame checks are meaningful), and fake enumerateDevices returning two videoinputs so the Flip button is enabled. Opener button is data-testid=open-camera-btn on /dashboard.
